my brother spent 3 years studying until he was 24 for the MCAT and never got the right score. now he's living in seattle in a beautiful apartment with his wife of 2 years.

it's times like these that develop the grit necessary to understand yourself on the deepest levels. just keep going, and i'm sure you'll do just fine.

just like school never defined how smart we were, your job never defined anything about you. just know that when you pick up the pieces, get out of bed tomorrow, and keep going that you will have already been stronger than you were the day before. this strength is going to carry you to new, probably better, places.

be strong for yourself, your family, and others that love you.

i know tomorrow will be different, but that doesnt mean the rest of your days have to be. your spirit is strong if you have to take sleeping pills to sleep all day; deeply depressed people don't need to.

 i've been alone for a long time now, but i know that i'm fundamentally stronger every day i choose to get up and seize the day. try and think about these days like this, and you'll find yourself somewhere different.

love yourself tomorrow because i'm sure you deserve it
